OUR APPROACH

From the first conversation to your visit

  1. Tell us what your vehicle needs.
  2. Discuss the service or diagnostic plan.
  3. Confirm availability with the shop.

Core services

Maintenance & service

Thoughtful upkeep starts with the right plan for your vehicle and the way you drive it.

Diagnostics & repair

A warning light, a new sound, or a change in how it drives. Start with a conversation about the concern, then a diagnostic plan before making repair decisions.

Brakes & suspension

Confidence is something you feel. Discuss braking concerns, uneven tire wear, ride quality, or changes in steering and handling.

Cooling & air conditioning

Houston heat is hard on cooling systems and air conditioning. Bring in overheating, coolant leaks, temperature warnings, or A/C that isn’t as cold as it should be.

Pre-purchase inspection

Get to know the car before making it yours. Ask about an inspection focused on condition, service needs, and the questions that matter to your purchase.

BEFORE YOUR VISIT

Service questions, answered

What vehicles do you service?

We service European makes including Porsche, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, and Audi.

Can I request a pre-purchase inspection?

Choose pre-purchase inspection and tell us about the vehicle you’re considering.

What should I include with my request?

Share your vehicle’s make and model, the issue you’re noticing, and any preferred dates.

Does submitting reserve an appointment?

The shop will contact you to confirm availability.
